'''This craft''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by [[Reymet Autem]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. He used this craft to escape [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with [[Sagoro Autem|his father]].<ref name="Republic 78">[[Republic 78|''Republic'' 78]]</ref>
